page.overview:
Who is Dalton?

Dalton is the elected king of the Sakura Kingdom (successor to the Drum Kingdom). He was formerly the of the Drum Kingdom under King Wapol. He also temporarily served as the captain of the civilian guard after the fall of Drum Kingdom.

He is an ally to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Drum Island Arc.

Dalton is an imposing tall man, with slicked black hair and a goatee. He wears a long, white fur-lined green tunic and has armor plates on his arms; these plates are retained on his fore legs when assuming his Beast Form. Sometimes he covers his head with a green and white fur lined hat, equipped with ear-flaps against Drum Island's intense cold, and he always wears long boots. He carries his weapon of choice, an extra-large spade, in a sheath that hangs on his back. In Chapter 0, he was seen wearing a more regal armor, and his hair was also parted in three points, instead of one.

After the timeskip, as the king of the country, he started wearing a fur-lined cape with the kingdom's symbol on it over his standard attire.
